method: Visual review of each Awwwards thumbnail on the review sheets, read beside the measured area of each recorded color (data/thumbnail-measures.json). One reviewer (Claude), 2026-11-09. Judgements, not measurements.

fields.ground: The color behind everything else. A number is the position of a recorded color in Awwwards order; "unrecorded: …" is a color visible in the thumbnail but not recorded; "image" means photography, illustration or a render fills the frame with no flat ground; "multicolor" means several flat colors share the ground.
fields.figure: The color that stands on the ground and carries the identity: type, the main shape or product. Same values as ground.
fields.accent: A small supporting color, if visible. Same values.
fields.mockup: The thumbnail shows the site in a device, card or frame on a backdrop. Ground and figure were judged from the site, not the backdrop.
fields.proposed_label: Set when the pair does not fit a flat primary (image-led, gradient-led, multicolor). The site counts as Unresolved, and the label is evidence for a missing category.

limits: Thumbnails are submitter images at 352×264 on the sheets; small type and accents may be missed.
Unrecorded colors are described in words, never assigned a value. Where a measured value is needed it comes from thumbnail pixels.
For category records, a recorded swatch stands for a family: a cream ground may be recorded as the yellow swatch.
